0022600021.text: The Dallas Mavericks host the Houston Rockets in a regular-season NBA Cup West Group A game, the Mavericks' sixth of the season, and Dallas enters at 3-2 overall (1-1 at home, 2-1 on the road) on a two-game win streak, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back, and 7th in the West. Houston comes in 5-0 (2-0 at home, 3-0 on the road) on a five-game win streak, sitting 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West. The 2026-27 season series is tied... no, Dallas trails 0-1 after a 128-110 loss in Houston on October 21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, with Dallas out Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), day-to-day Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) both listed as game-time decisions, and Houston out Marcus Smart (forearm strain), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), with Alperen Sengun day-to-day (back soreness) and a game-time decision.
